title: Protecting collective worth: pride in European parliament campaigns in Germany, Hungary, and Poland

live_model.evidence: "Underrepresented categories were augmented with synthetic examples generated using OpenAI's GPT-4-turbo in a 10-shot prompting setting."; Generative AI statement: "OpenAI GPT-4-turbo was used to generate synthetic examples for data augmentation during the development of the multilingual emotion classifier."

prompt.location: n/a - only described as "10-shot prompting", no template or example reproduced

claim.metric: none for GPT-4-turbo itself; the reported 72% accuracy / 0.72 macro F1 belongs to a separately fine-tuned XLM-RoBERTa pride-detection classifier

data.source: Widmann and Wich (2023) German emotion dataset (public); MORES project Facebook-post corpus and expert annotations (not stated as released)

notes: GPT-4-turbo is only a synthetic-data generator (role A) for training-set balancing; the paper's headline accuracy is that of a downstream fine-tuned XLM-RoBERTa classifier, not of GPT-4-turbo.
